faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Got Questions? We've Got Answers
faqs.a1: We offer a full range of mobile pet grooming services including bathing, haircuts, nail trimming, ear cleaning, flea & tick treatments, and more. All done in the comfort of your home!
faqs.a2: Our fully equipped grooming van comes directly to your door. Your pet is groomed one-on-one in a stress-free environment, without cages or waiting around other animals.
faqs.a3: We currently service Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties in South Florida.
faqs.q4: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a4: You can book online through our website, call us directly, or send us a message through our contact form.
faqs.q5: How long does a grooming session take?
faqs.a5: A typical session takes between 1 to 2 hours depending on the size of your pet and the services requested.
faqs.q6: Do I need to be home during the appointment?
faqs.a6: Yes, we recommend being home during the appointment. You'll need to bring your pet to the grooming van and pick them up when they're done.
faqs.a7: We groom all dog breeds and sizes! From Chihuahuas to Great Danes, every pet is welcome.
faqs.a8: Yes! We offer cat grooming services including bathing, brushing, nail trimming, and lion cuts.
faqs.q9: What if my pet has special needs?
faqs.a9: We're experienced with pets of all temperaments and needs. Please let us know about any special requirements when booking so we can prepare accordingly.
faqs.q10: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a10: We accept cash, credit/debit cards, Zelle, and Venmo.
